name: gdn_mega_bwd_cached_v7
timing: Synchronized wall time. Backward consumes buffers from forward and includes allocation/enqueue; forward execution is excluded. Forward denominator is forward_cache_ms with cache writes and preallocated buffers.
validation: 60 measured cached configurations, five forward and backward samples per case; 20 unsupported cache producers are N/A. All supported benchmark cases also check cached and uncached forward outputs are bitwise equal.
notes: No uncached backward times are substituted for unsupported forward shapes.
TP divides both head counts per device; communication is excluded.
Kernel code unchanged from the 113-test-passing v7 runtime.
